Referral Note

Urgent evaluation requested by family. Mr. Hensley is a 27-year-old man brought in today by his sister, who reports about three weeks of behavior that is out of character for him: very little sleep with a lot of energy, leaving his full-time job to start a business, and roughly $15,000 in purchases across several credit cards. He has had no prior psychiatric treatment, takes no medications, is medically healthy, and denies alcohol or drug use. He states that he has “never felt better.” Please provide a diagnostic assessment and treatment recommendations, including the appropriate level of care.

Behavioral Observations (on arrival)

Appearance: Casually dressed with mildly disheveled grooming. Arrived carrying a backpack of notebooks and a laptop holding his business plans, which he tried to show the front-desk staff.

Behavior: Alert. Excessively talkative, frequently changes topics, and easily distracted during the interview.

Speech: Rapid and pressured.

Mood / Affect: Mood “fantastic.” Affect expansive.

Thought / Perception: Thought process shows flight of ideas. Grandiose thought content is present. No hallucinations.

Cognition / Insight: Alert and oriented. Insight poor. Judgment significantly impaired.
